# Product comparison

| Product | Price | Project limit | Retention | Export |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Atlas | 120 USD | 40 projects | 7 days | CSV |
| Birch | 180 USD | 75 projects | 14 days | JSON |
| Cedar | 240 USD | 90 projects | 30 days | XML |

## Recommendation

If you want the lowest price, choose **Atlas**. If you want the best overall value for balancing capacity and retention, **Birch** is the strongest middle ground. If you need the highest project limit and longest retention, choose **Cedar**.
